LanguageData.DMSE.Platform.RemoveDesc: Remove space platforms or vacstone ground, leaving open space and recovering some materials.
LanguageData.DMSE.Platform.Settings.SpaceTraversal: Allow walking on open space (restart required)
LanguageData.DMSE.Platform.Settings.SpaceTraversalDes: Enable the patch that makes vanilla open space passable. Disabled by default. Changes take effect after restarting the game. Other mods may also change space passability.
